shortDescription: Manages a TSIG key in a PowerDNS Authoritative server

options.name: algorithm
options.description: The message digest algorithm, as specified by RFC 2845 and its updates, which will be used to validate requests including this key. Required when C(state) is C(present).

options.name: api_key
options.description: Key (token) used to authenticate to the API endpoint in the server.

options.name: api_spec_path
options.description: Path of the OpenAPI (Swagger) API spec document in C(api_url).

options.name: api_url
options.description: URL of the API endpoint in the server.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the key to be managed.

options.name: server_id
options.description: ID of the server instance which holds the key.

options.name: state
options.description: If C(present) the key will be created if necessary; if it already exists, its configuration will be updated to match the provided attributes. If C(absent) the key will be removed it if exists. If C(exists) the key's existence will be checked, but it will not be modified.
